title: Trading Card Game Players Problem Space Map
description: What trading card game players are trying to get done, grouped by purpose, with how satisfied they are and the products they use.
note: Themes regrouped with the purpose-graphing skill from AI-assisted summaries of a study; satisfaction derived from participants' statements scored by an AI-assisted analysis pipeline; 10 participants (5 interviews, 5 Digimon TCG podcast hosts); only themes raised by 2+ people.
